text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Uniform looks good! Hair looks good!
And in the bag—salad rice crackers, good!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria, at 100 miles of energy!!
Let's give it our all today, too~! Yeah~!
(Pitter-patter...)
(Pitter-patter...)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Alright! My personal rule,
'Walk behind Rob Roy-senpai!' Complete♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's have breakfast!
I'll have a sandwich so I can read my book—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: A large salad for me again today, please!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"—Phew... My muscles are fatigued...
Need to recover... with protein."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Kris S-senpai!
I'm guessing you're on your way back from morning muscle training, right?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Please, let me massage your shoulders!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
1, 2, 3 mile!
2, 2, 3 mile!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: “Shoulder massage for Kris S-senpai after weight training!” Complete! It promotes blood circulation, so your muscles can absorb nutrients like crazy~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Taiki-senpai, Taiki-senpai~!!
Guess what? I got some exquisite, freshly-picked morning veggies!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wow! Which means—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~! Yummy☆
Crisp veggies and juicy meat are the absolute best, yes!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! "Party with Taiki-senpai
once we get delicious veggies!" Mission complete!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
A new crepe shop just opened!
Which means—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Hello?
Wait, really?! A new crepe shop opened?!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Ah, of course! Let's go together next time!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "Deliver the good news to Bubble-senpai by phone!" complete!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look at the time.
My own rules are all set, and all that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Training time, right!
Come on, Trainer, let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Hold on just a minute with that training!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
A "thank-you gift"?
I appreciate it, but did I do something to deserve this...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Gran-san's rule,
we can always greet a bright morning.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Fatigue... easily accumulates in my body.
So... this is a great help.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Eating meals with Gran!
It is super delicious and super fun☆

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Haha, me too! Eating dessert with you, Gran,
is the best reward of all!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
All I wanted was to eat and chat
with everyone, but...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Every single one was just a personal rule for myself.
And yet, to think they gave everyone energy—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: —Ehehe! As expected of me!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to keep following my own rules from now on too!
So brace yourselves, seniors♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...!!
Nnnngh, I can't take it anymore!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Huggy-hug, squeezeee♡
Gran, you are just way too cute~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"T-Taiki-senpai!? Mmph!!
I can do that too... *HUUUUG*!!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I haven't had nearly enough yet!
So give me some good-girl headpats, please♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Then... I shall—toss him in the air...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Nice! Everyone's really letting loose!
choice_data_list: Then I'll treat you to a feast for dinner.
Then for me, a feast for dinner.
That really makes me want to push harder in training!
That really makes me want to push harder in training!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Nice! Everyone's really letting loose!
choice_data_list: Then I'll treat you to a feast for dinner.
Then for me, a feast for dinner.
That really makes me want to push harder in training!
That really makes me want to push harder in training!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Really?! Woohoo~!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe!
I'm looking forward to the salad bar with you, Trainer-san♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Whew... Ehehe, it really is.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... I swear I'll live up to your cheers.
I definitely, definitely will!!
